text.p: Belgian glass maker Glaverbel, a unit of Japan's Asahi Glass, said on Friday its automotive arm Glavunion-Thorax will become a wholly-owned separate unit in January 1997 and be renamed Splintex Czech.

The move will enable Splintex's main operations in Belgium and the Czech Republic "to act as a unit and integrate industrial and marketing policy into a global European strategy," Glaverbel said in a statement.
The Czech arm of Splintex (formerly Glavunion) was incorporated by Glaverbel in 1991 and completed an investment programme in 1994.
As a result of this modernisation programme, all operations of Splintex Czech meet the ISO 9001 international quality standard.

The creation of Splintex Czech is a further attempt to "enable the plants to specialise more efficiently and rationalise their production in response to the increasingly strict demands of automotive manufacturers," Glaverbel said.
